comingLast.roast: level pegging with Williams - the countback rules are being googled at the bar
2 to play, 3 to find - the gallery (the bar) is invested
deadlocked with Miller for the double blue - the bar has picked sides
finished 2 above the blue line - toasting every point Miller does not score
2 above Miller from the clubhouse - it never felt so thin from a chair
2 points clear from the bar - watching Miller like a hawk with a beer
3 clear and finished - now a full-time Miller supporter
in the clubhouse 3 clear - his card is safe, his pride pending
his round is over, his sweating is not - 4 above the line
in on a 4-point buffer - watching the door like everyone else
